newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Air Force hopes to close 50-year-old UFO case.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Air Force hopes to close 50-year-old UFO case.

text.p: The U.S. Air Force will release a final report on Tuesday again denying that space aliens in flying saucers crashed near Roswell, New Mexico, 50 years ago, defence officials said on Monday.

The officials confirmed an NBC report that the Air Force's "case closed" report on the incident explains that unusual activities in the desert in 1947 involved military launch and recovery operations of experimental high-altitude balloons.

The defence officials, who asked not to be identified, said "aliens" observed in the desert not far from Roswell were apparently test dummies carried aloft by U.S. Air Force balloons for scientific research.

Everyone agrees something fell from the sky onto ranchland near Roswell during the summer of 1947 but, while the official explanation is that it was a high-altitude balloon, a growing number of UFO enthusiasts and anti-government conspiracy theorists are convinced there was a cover-up.
Frank Kaufmann, now 81 and one of the few witnesses to the so-called "Roswell Incident," still insists he saw dead aliens put into body bags after their spacecraft crashed near the town 50 years ago.
But the Air Force has repeatedly denied the claims and says it has no evidence of alien spacecraft or that there has been any UFO cover-up.
